note: Ask 2 of #4351 -- the 2022-08-15 comment by `sparkkk`: "not only for struct members, but the types of unused function parameters would also be removed incorrectly." The comment carries no shader and no command line, so case-fn-param.hlsl is AGENT-CONSTRUCTED to the narrowest reading of that sentence, and this predicate is scored separately from match.json so that neither ask can borrow the other's verdict. The shader is deliberately self-controlling: `Helper` takes two struct parameters, one read in the body and one not, and the two types are otherwise identical. Clause 2 is therefore an in-run positive self-test -- the READ parameter's type must survive -- so a build that simply deleted every struct definition, or a rewriter that emitted nothing, cannot score a reproduction on the strength of clause 3's absence. Clause 1 is the reference that makes the removal incorrect (the retained signature still names the type). Clause 4 proves the rewrite completed rather than a diagnostic quoting a source line, and clause 5 proves a rewriter option was honoured, since dxr prints `// Rewrite unchanged result:` (tools/clang/tools/libclang/dxcrewriteunused.cpp:1087) only when neither -remove-unused-globals nor -remove-unused-functions was set.
